description: Composition of the 82-peptide core holdup panel: class I content, which peptides ARHGAP21 binds, and corrected ARHGAP23 peptide-level table
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_excel(pd.ExcelFile("Gogl2022_SupplementaryData1.xlsx"), "PDZ-PBM interactome")
df = df[["PDZ","PBM","peptide","COMP_neglogKd"]].copy()
df["COMP_neglogKd"] = pd.to_numeric(df["COMP_neglogKd"], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)

PHI = set("VILMFYWAC")
def pbm_class(p):
    p = str(p).strip().upper().replace("-","")
    if len(p) < 3 or p[-1] not in PHI: return "non-canonical / not Phi at P0"
    m2 = p[-3]
    if m2 in "ST": return "I  (S/T-x-Phi)"
    if m2 in PHI: return "II (Phi-x-Phi)"
    if m2 in "DE": return "III (D/E-x-Phi)"
    return "other P-2"

a23 = df[df.PDZ=="ARHGAP23"].copy()
a21 = df[df.PDZ=="ARHGAP21"].set_index("PBM")["COMP_neglogKd"]
a23["class"] = a23.peptide.map(pbm_class)
a23["P-2"] = a23.peptide.str.strip().str.upper().str[-3]
a23["ARHGAP21_pKd"] = a23.PBM.map(a21)
a23 = a23.rename(columns={"COMP_neglogKd":"ARHGAP23_pKd"})

print("ARHGAP23 core panel: n =", len(a23), " binders =", int((a23.ARHGAP23_pKd>0).sum()),
      " max pKd =", a23.ARHGAP23_pKd.max())
print("\nclass composition of the 82-peptide core panel, and how ARHGAP21 scores on it:")
tab = a23.groupby("class").apply(lambda d: pd.Series({
    "n_peptides": len(d),
    "ARHGAP23_binders": int((d.ARHGAP23_pKd>0).sum()),
    "ARHGAP21_binders": int((d.ARHGAP21_pKd>0).sum()),
    "ARHGAP21_max_pKd": round(d.ARHGAP21_pKd.max(),2)})).astype({"n_peptides":int})
print(tab.to_string())

print("\nPeptides ARHGAP21 binds in this shared panel (ARHGAP23 scores 0 on every one):")
w = a23[a23.ARHGAP21_pKd>0].sort_values("ARHGAP21_pKd",ascending=False)[
    ["PBM","peptide","class","ARHGAP21_pKd","ARHGAP23_pKd"]]
print(w.to_string(index=False))

a23.sort_values("ARHGAP21_pKd",ascending=False).to_csv("profaff_ARHGAP23_core_panel_82.csv", index=False)
tab.to_csv("profaff_core_panel_class_composition.csv")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.2))
d = w.head(23)
y = np.arange(len(d))
ax.barh(y+0.2, d.ARHGAP21_pKd, height=0.4, color="navy", label="ARHGAP21 PDZ")
ax.barh(y-0.2, d.ARHGAP23_pKd, height=0.4, color="crimson", label="ARHGAP23 PDZ (all zero)")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(d.PBM, fontsize=8); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel("pKd  (0 = no detectable binding)")
ax.set_title("Same 82-peptide panel, same assay: ARHGAP21 binds 23, ARHGAP23 binds none")
ax.legend(frameon=False, loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
